legal.privacyBody: Wasla lets people who scan your car tag reach you. To create your account we keep your name, email address and password; when you add a car, its plate and model; when you chat, the message text. Your plate and name are never shown to people who scan the tag. Numbers you add as emergency contacts can be seen by anyone who scans the tag. Messages are sent as plain text only, with nothing that identifies you or your car, to a check for inappropriate content. You can delete your account at any time. This text is a draft and will be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
